data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"As n grows, the probability of reaching unanimous consensus tends to 1: the set of initial colorings that flow into a nontrivial stable matching cut has exponentially small measure, so whp consensus is reached, and the prevalence of obstruction structures scales exponentially: the number of stable matching cuts in a random 3-regular graph is exp(\u0398(n)) but their total basin weight is exp(-\u0398(n))\u00b7exp(\u0398(n)) = o(1) because a uniformly random coloring is exponentially unlikely to descend into any fixed trap.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If basins of stable matching cuts cover a constant fraction of the configuration space, consensus \u2192 constant","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the descent dynamics concentrates mass onto traps (dynamical focusing), consensus \u2192 0","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"Simulations on n up to 10^4 showing consensus frequency below 0.9 falsify this","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"A stable matching cut requires every vertex to have \u22652 same-color neighbors, forcing the cut edges to be an induced matching with each side 2-of-3 stable. On the locally tree-like random 3-regular graph, the number of such configurations is exp(\u0398(n)) but each individual one has basin of attraction exponentially small: to descend into a given stable matching cut, the trajectory must make a specific sequence of exp(\u0398(n))-unlikely choices at the terminal stage. A union bound over the exp(\u0398(n)) traps gives total trapping probability exp(\u0398(n))\u00b7exp(-\u0398(n)) = o(1) provided the per-trap basin weight is exp(-cn) with c larger than the trap-count entropy rate. This is the discriminating quantity and is falsifiable: measure consensus frequency vs n; if it decays toward a constant, the union bound constant c is smaller than the entropy rate.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
